patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents messages deleted by other users from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once photos, videos and voice messages viewable indefinitely.

patches.name: Anti-screenshot notification
patches.description: Blocks screenshot notifications from being sent to the other user.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Allows opening, viewing, saving and forwarding content from restricted, sensitive, and copyright-restricted channels.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Allows saving and forwarding content from restricted channels, chats, and users.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches.name: Bypass translation restrictions
patches.description: Keeps the translation UI available when a chat or user has disabled translations.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Blocks Firebase analytics and event tracking in Telegram Plus. FirebaseApp.initializeApp() is preserved so push notifications keep working.

patches.name: Disable auto-update
patches.description: Disables Telegram update availability/state and the update-state refresh path for Telegram 12.10.4 without replacing the update UI method wholesale.

patches.name: Disable channel switching
patches.description: Disables the pull-down gesture that switches to the next unread channel.

patches.name: Download speed boost
patches.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description:
Fixes Firebase services (push notifications, Remote Config, Firebase Auth) that break after Morphe re-signs the app with a different certificate.

Apply with Original app certificate patch — no other config needed.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats. On Telegram Plus also silences the controller-level sendTyping dispatcher.

patches.name: Provide Original app certificate
patches.description: Automatically reads the signing certificate from the APK you are patching — no original app installed or file provided needed. Only fill the options below if you are patching an APK that was already re-signed (e.g. a previously patched build): in that case point to the original APK file, or enter the certificate manually.

options.title: Path to original APK (if uninstalled)
options.description: Full path to the original APK or .apks bundle. Example: /sdcard/Download/Waze.apks

options.title: Certificate SHA-1 (manual)
options.description: 40-char hex. Found on APKMirror under app signature info.

options.title: Certificate Base64 DER (manual)
options.description: Needed only for Signature spoof patch. Get it with: apksigner verify --print-certs original.apk

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads from all chats and channels. On Telegram Plus also blocks native banner and inline ads.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description:
Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it.

Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate.

Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.

Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: Package name override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description:
Makes the app think it was installed from a specific store (default: Google Play).

Useful when an app blocks features or shows errors because it detects it was not installed from the Play Store.

Only affects what the app itself sees - does not change the real system install record.

options.title: Store to impersonate
options.description: Most apps only check for the Google Play Store, so the default is usually correct. Pick from the list, or type any package name directly if your app checks for a different store.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features for the current account.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Skips Telegram 12.10.4's Rich HTML branch while preserving normal clipboard handling.

patches.name: Voice to music
patches.description: Plays voice notes in the full music player with seek bar and background playback.
